name: Alpha Hound
description: the pack leader of the Magma King's slag hounds: a huge muscular wolf-like hound of black cooled slag, a thick mane of molten lava, glowing cinders trapped behind its cracked ribs, scars, burning yellow eyes, a glowing maw full of jagged teeth, four legs on the ground

poses.stand: standing on all four legs side-on, head high, the lava mane blazing
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: stands growling on all fours, the lava mane rippling

move.action: trots forward on all four legs, the lava mane streaming, staying in the same spot in the frame

attack.action: crouches low with its mane flaring, then lunges forward to the right with its jaws wide open, then pulls up

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
